# OpenBridge widget reference

<!-- Generated by tools/openbridge/make-widgets.py — do not edit by hand. -->

Grid: **24 px**. OpenBridge: **1.0.0**. Placement: `left = node.x × 24 − anchor.x`, `top = node.y × 24 − anchor.y` (see [openbridge.md](openbridge.md)). P&ID widgets are anchored at their connection point; all other widgets at their top-left corner and they fill their box (resize freely, in 24 px steps).

Direction: **read** = tag → widget, **write** = widget → tag (command), **rw** = shown and written by the operator (bind the same tag, e.g. a setpoint).
